definition_en: to keep something for future use, or a supply kept in readiness
core_image: 仓库深处留着一批物资，标签上写着「备用」
scene: 他们在车库后面留了几箱水，以备停电时使用。They reserved several boxes of water behind the garage in case the power failed.
sceneCN: 这里 reserve 是「保留」（第 1 个义项：留作以后使用）；句意：他们在车库后面留了几箱水，以备停电时使用。

senses.title: To keep for future use
senses.definition: to keep something so that it can be used later
senses.definitionCN: 把某物留存下来，供以后使用
senses.example: They reserved several boxes of water behind the garage.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在车库后面留了几箱水。
senses.why: The Latin verb means to keep back, which is the core of every sense.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词意为保留，这是所有义项的核心。

senses.title: A supply kept ready
senses.definition: an amount of something kept for use in an emergency or later
senses.definitionCN: 为紧急情况或以后使用而储存的数量
senses.example: The army kept a reserve of fuel.
senses.exampleCN: 军队储备了燃料。
senses.why: The noun names the thing that has been kept back.
senses.whyCN: 名词指被保留下来的东西。

senses.title: Self-restraint
senses.definition: the habit of not showing feelings or thoughts openly
senses.definitionCN: 不轻易外露情感或想法的习惯
senses.example: He spoke with reserve about his own success.
senses.exampleCN: 他谈到自己的成功时很克制。
senses.why: Feelings kept back from view produce the social sense of reserve.
senses.whyCN: 情感被留在视线之外，就产生「矜持」这一社交含义。

intro.en: Reserve comes from Latin reservare, to keep back, from re- and servare, to keep, through Old French reserver.
intro.cn: reserve 来自拉丁语 reservare（保留），由 re- 与 servare（保存）构成，经古法语 reserver 进入英语。

items.en: Servare means to keep or preserve.
items.cn: servare 意为保存、保全。

items.en: Reservare means to keep back for later.
items.cn: reservare 意为留到以后。

items.en: Reserver means to reserve or hold back.
items.cn: reserver 意为保留、扣下。

items.en: Middle English reserven means to keep back.
items.cn: 中古英语 reserven 意为保留。

items.en: Reserve appears as a noun for a supply kept ready.
items.cn: 到 16 世纪，reserve 作为名词出现，指备用的储备。

items.en: Modern English adds the sense of personal restraint.
items.cn: 现代英语增加了「个人克制」这一义项。

note.en: Reserve is a keeping-back word, and it sits near its family and near verbs for keeping and booking.
note.cn: reserve 是一个「留住」词，与自身词族以及表示保存和预订的动词相邻。

entries.definition: a member of a reserve force
to keep something for future use
to arrange to use something in advance

normalIntro.en: Reserve is re- plus the Latin root for keep: to keep something back for later.
normalIntro.cn: reserve 是 re- 加拉丁语「保存」词根：把东西留到以后。

normal.en: Reserve a table means keep it for a future time.
normal.cn: reserve a table 意为把桌子留到以后用。

normal.en: A nature reserve is land kept for wildlife.
normal.cn: nature reserve 是为野生动物保留的土地。

normal.en: In reserve means held ready but not yet used.
normal.cn: in reserve 意为留作备用、尚未使用。

normal.en: Reserved can describe a quiet, restrained person.
normal.cn: reserved 可以形容安静、克制的人。

normal.en: Compare keep: keep is general, while reserve stresses setting aside.
normal.cn: 对比 keep：keep 更泛，reserve 强调「单独留出来」。

abstract.en: Picture boxes stacked at the back of a garage.
abstract.cn: 想象车库深处堆着几只箱子。

abstract.en: Imagine a fuel gauge with a hidden lower section.
abstract.cn: 想象油表下面还藏着一段备用油量。

abstract.en: Think of a quiet person holding words back.
abstract.cn: 想象一个安静的人把话留在心里。

examples.en: Please reserve a table for two.
examples.cn: 请订一张两人桌。

examples.en: They reserved several boxes of water behind the garage.
examples.cn: 他们在车库后面留了几箱水。

examples.en: The nature reserve protects rare birds.
examples.cn: 自然保护区保护稀有鸟类。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「re + serve」——留下来以后再用，就是保留；这只是构词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 servare（保存）→ reservare（保留）→ 古法语 reserver → 中古英语 reserven → 现代英语 reserve，核心义「留住备用」。

sensesIntro.en: The word keeps one image, holding something back: a thing kept for later, a supply set aside, and feelings kept out of sight.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个词始终保留一个意象——把东西留住：留待以后之物、单列出来的储备，以及不外露的情感。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a supply set aside with a label saying for later.
core.cn: 核心意象：一批物资被单独放好，标签写着「留待以后」。

branches.en: Keeping something for later is the core verb sense.
branches.cn: 留作后用，是核心动词义项。

branches.en: A reserve is the supply that has been set aside.
branches.cn: 储备就是被单独留出的物资。

branches.en: Reserve of manner is feeling kept back from view.
branches.cn: 举止上的矜持，是情感被留在视线之外。

branches.en: The act of reserving creates the thing held in reserve.
branches.cn: 保留的行为造出了储备之物。

branches.en: A hidden supply and hidden feeling share the same restraint.
branches.cn: 隐藏的物资与隐藏的情感共享同一种克制。

intro.en: Reserve is a Latin verb reshaped by French, and English endings form its modern family.
intro.cn: reserve 是经法语改造的拉丁动词，现代词族由英语词尾构成。

latinIntro.en: Latin servare means to keep, and reservare means to keep back.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 servare 意为保存，reservare 意为保留。

items.example: Re- adds the idea of keeping back.
items.exampleCN: re- 增添「留在后面」的意思。

items.example: Reserver carries the verb into French.
items.exampleCN: reserver 把这个动词带入法语。

items.meaningCN: 表示动作或结果的词尾

definition_zh: 居民；住户；住院医生；居住的
definition_en: a person who lives in a place, or living in a place
core_image: 清晨的街区，每扇门后都走出一位熟悉的面孔
scene: 每到周末，这条街的居民会把旧家具搬到人行道上出售。Every weekend, the residents of this street put old furniture out on the pavement to sell.
sceneCN: 这里 resident 是「居民」（第 1 个义项：在某地居住的人）；句意：每到周末，这条街的居民会把旧家具搬到人行道上出售。

senses.title: A person who lives in a place
senses.definition: someone who lives in a particular house, street, or town
senses.definitionCN: 住在某栋房子、某条街或某个城镇的人
senses.example: The residents of the street meet every spring.
senses.exampleCN: 这条街的居民每年春天聚会。
senses.why: The -ent ending names the person who carries out the action of residing.
senses.whyCN: 词尾 -ent 指执行「居住」这一动作的人。

senses.title: A doctor in hospital training
senses.definition: a doctor who has finished medical school and is training in a hospital
senses.definitionCN: 医学院毕业后在医院接受培训的医生
senses.example: She is a resident doctor at the city hospital.
senses.exampleCN: 她是市医院的住院医生。
senses.why: The doctor lives at the hospital during training, so the residing word fits the role.
senses.whyCN: 这类医生在培训期间住在医院，因此「居住」这个词也适用于这一身份。

senses.title: Living in a place
senses.definition: living permanently in a particular place, used before a noun
senses.definitionCN: 长期住在某处，用于名词前
senses.example: A resident cat sleeps by the fire.
senses.exampleCN: 一只常驻的猫睡在炉火旁。
senses.why: The adjective describes whatever stays in place rather than visiting.
senses.whyCN: 形容词描述长期待在那里而非临时来访的人或动物。

intro.en: Resident comes from Latin residens, dwelling, the present participle of residere, to remain behind.
intro.cn: resident 来自拉丁语 residens（居住的），是 residere（留下）的现在分词。

items.en: Sedere means to sit.
items.cn: sedere 意为坐。

items.en: Residere means to remain behind or dwell.
items.cn: residere 意为留下、居住。

items.en: Residens means dwelling or remaining.
items.cn: residens 意为居住的、留下的。

items.en: Resident means dwelling in a place.
items.cn: resident 意为在某地居住的。

items.en: English resident names a person who lives in a place.
items.cn: 到 17 世纪，英语 resident 指在某地居住的人。

items.en: Modern English adds the medical trainee sense.
items.cn: 现代英语增加了「住院医生」这一义项。

note.en: Resident is the person noun of reside, and it sits near its family and near words for inhabitants.
note.cn: resident 是 reside 的人物名词，与自身词族以及表示居民的问相邻。

entries.definition: a person or animal living in a place
a legally recognized member of a country
a person who lives in or uses a place

normalIntro.en: Resident is the person who resides: the one who lives there.
normalIntro.cn: resident 就是 reside 的人：住在那里的人。

normal.en: Add -ent to reside and you get the person.
normal.cn: 在 reside 后加 -ent，就得到那个人。

normal.en: Local resident is the usual newspaper phrase.
normal.cn: local resident 是新闻中常用的说法。

normal.en: A resident doctor lives at the hospital during training.
normal.cn: 住院医生在培训期间住在医院。

normal.en: Resident can also be an adjective: a resident cat.
normal.cn: resident 也可作形容词：a resident cat。

normal.en: Compare inhabitant: inhabitant is more formal and less common.
normal.cn: 对比 inhabitant：inhabitant 更正式，也更少用。

abstract.en: Picture a street where every door has a familiar face.
abstract.cn: 想象一条街，每扇门后都是熟悉的面孔。

abstract.en: Imagine a doctor's coat hanging in a hospital room at night.
abstract.cn: 想象夜里医院房间里挂着一件白大褂。

abstract.en: Think of a cat that has slept by the same fire for years.
abstract.cn: 想象一只猫在同一炉火旁睡了多年。

examples.en: The residents of the street meet every spring.
examples.cn: 这条街的居民每年春天聚会。

examples.en: She is a resident doctor at the city hospital.
examples.cn: 她是市医院的住院医生。

examples.en: A resident cat sleeps by the fire.
examples.cn: 一只常驻的猫睡在炉火旁。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「reside + ent」——居住在那里的那个人，就是居民；这只是构词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 sedere（坐）→ residere（留下、居住）→ residens（居住的）→ 古法语 resident → 现代英语 resident。

sensesIntro.en: The word names the person who lives in a place, then a doctor who lives at a hospital during training, and can also describe anyone or anything staying in place.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个词先指在某地居住的人，再指培训期间住在医院的医生，也可描述任何长期待在某处的人或物。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a familiar face stepping out of the same door each morning.
core.cn: 核心意象：每天清晨从同一扇门走出的熟悉面孔。

branches.en: A person living in a place is the main sense.
branches.cn: 在某地居住的人，是主要义项。

branches.en: The medical resident lives at the hospital while training.
branches.cn: 住院医生在培训期间住在医院。

branches.en: The adjective describes what stays rather than visits.
branches.cn: 形容词描述长期留下而非来访者。

branches.en: A person and an animal can both be resident somewhere.
branches.cn: 人与动物都可以是某地的常驻者。

branches.en: Both senses depend on living in a particular place.
branches.cn: 两个义项都依赖「住在特定地方」。

intro.en: Resident is an English -ent noun and adjective built on the Latin verb residere.
intro.cn: resident 是建立在拉丁动词 residere 上的英语 -ent 名词兼形容词。

latinIntro.en: Latin sedere means to sit, residere means to remain, and residens means dwelling.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 sedere 意为坐，residere 意为留下，residens 意为居住的。

items.example: Re- adds the sense of remaining.

items.meaningCN: 表示状态或动作的词尾

definition_en: consisting of homes rather than shops or factories
core_image: 一排排房子、草坪和信箱，没有厂房和店铺
scene: 这片区域全是住宅街道，夜里安静得只听见风声。The area is made up of residential streets that grow silent at night.
sceneCN: 这里 residential 是「住宅的」（第 1 个义项：由住宅构成的）；句意：这片区域全是住宅街道，夜里安静得只听见风声。

senses.title: Consisting of homes
senses.definition: made up of houses where people live rather than businesses
senses.definitionCN: 由人们居住的房屋构成，而非商业场所
senses.example: They live in a quiet residential area.
senses.exampleCN: 他们住在一个安静的住宅区。
senses.why: The -ial adjective describes an area whose purpose is residence.
senses.whyCN: -ial 形容词描述以居住为目的的区域。

senses.title: Involving living on site
senses.definition: connected with living in a place while studying or receiving care
senses.definitionCN: 与在学习或接受照护期间住在某处有关
senses.example: The college offers residential courses in summer.
senses.exampleCN: 这所学院在夏季开设住宿课程。
senses.why: The word extends from homes to institutions where people also live.
senses.whyCN: 这个词从家庭扩展到人们同样居住的机构。

senses.title: Used for housing
senses.definition: designed or used as housing rather than for another purpose
senses.definitionCN: 设计或用作住房，而非其他用途
senses.example: Residential buildings line both sides of the road.
senses.exampleCN: 道路两旁都是住宅楼。
senses.why: Any building can be classified by whether it is meant for living in.
senses.whyCN: 任何建筑都可按是否用于居住来分类。

intro.en: Residential is residence plus the adjective ending -ial, from Latin residentia, a dwelling.
intro.cn: residential 是 residence 加形容词词尾 -ial，源于拉丁语 residentia（居所）。

items.en: Sedere means to sit.
items.cn: sedere 意为坐。

items.en: Residere means to remain or dwell.
items.cn: residere 意为留下、居住。

items.en: Residentia means a dwelling.
items.cn: residentia 意为居所。

items.en: Residence means a place of dwelling.
items.cn: residence 意为居住之处。

items.en: Residential forms the adjective for areas of homes.
items.cn: 到 19 世纪，residential 构成描述住宅区域的形容词。

items.en: Modern English uses residential for areas, buildings, and care.
items.cn: 现代英语中，residential 用于区域、建筑与照护。

note.en: Residential is the adjective of residence, and it sits near its family and near words for housing and suburbs.
note.cn: residential 是 residence 的形容词，与自身词族以及表示住房和郊区的词相邻。

entries.definition: a person who lives in a place
relating to an area outside a city centre

normalIntro.en: Residential adds -ial to resident: describing an area made of homes.
normalIntro.cn: residential 在 resident 后加 -ial：描述由住宅构成的区域。

normal.en: Residential area is the most common phrase.
normal.cn: residential area 是最常见的短语。

normal.en: Residential streets have houses, not factories.
normal.cn: 住宅街道上是房屋，而不是工厂。

normal.en: Residential care means living in a care home.
normal.cn: residential care 指住在护理机构中。

normal.en: Residential property is housing rather than offices.
normal.cn: 住宅房产是住房而非办公场所。

normal.en: Compare suburban: suburban describes location, while residential describes use.
normal.cn: 对比 suburban：suburban 描述位置，residential 描述用途。

abstract.en: Picture rows of mailboxes and trimmed lawns.
abstract.cn: 想象一排排信箱和修剪整齐的草坪。

abstract.en: Imagine curtains closing one by one at dusk.
abstract.cn: 想象黄昏时窗帘一扇接一扇拉上。

abstract.en: Think of a street with no shop signs at all.
abstract.cn: 想象一条完全没有店铺招牌的街。

examples.en: They live in a quiet residential area.
examples.cn: 他们住在一个安静的住宅区。

examples.en: The college offers residential courses in summer.
examples.cn: 这所学院在夏季开设住宿课程。

examples.en: Residential buildings line both sides of the road.
examples.cn: 道路两旁都是住宅楼。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「resident + ial」——满是住户的地方，就是住宅区；这只是构词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 sedere（坐）→ residere（留下、居住）→ residentia（居所）→ residence ＋ -ial → residential。

sensesIntro.en: The adjective classifies places by living: a neighbourhood of homes, a course where students live in, and a building meant for housing.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个形容词按「居住」给场所分类：由住宅构成的街区、学生住校的课程，以及用于住房的建筑。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: rows of homes with lawns and letterboxes, no shop signs.
core.cn: 核心意象：一排排带草坪和信箱的住宅，没有店铺招牌。

branches.en: An area of homes is the main modern sense.
branches.cn: 住宅区域，是现代主要义项。

branches.en: Living in while studying or receiving care extends the idea.
branches.cn: 在学习或照护期间居住，扩展了这一概念。

branches.en: A building used for housing is residential property.
branches.cn: 用作住房的建筑就是住宅房产。

branches.en: Areas and individual buildings can both be residential.
branches.cn: 区域与单栋建筑都可以是住宅性的。

branches.en: Institutions and buildings both provide space for living.
branches.cn: 机构与建筑都提供居住空间。

intro.en: Residential is an English -ial adjective built on residence, from the Latin verb for remaining.
intro.cn: residential 是建立在 residence 上的英语 -ial 形容词，源于表示「留下」的拉丁动词。

latinIntro.en: Latin sedere means to sit and residentia means a dwelling; French residence carries the noun onward.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 sedere 意为坐，residentia 意为居所；法语 residence 把这个名词继续传递。

definition_en: to officially leave a job, or to accept something you cannot change
core_image: 一个人把办公室钥匙放在桌上，签下最后一笔
scene: 董事会改组后，财务总监当天就递交了辞呈。After the board was reshuffled, the finance director resigned that same day.
sceneCN: 这里 resign 是「辞职」（第 1 个义项：正式离开职位）；句意：董事会改组后，财务总监当天就辞职了。

senses.title: To leave a job officially
senses.definition: to state formally that you are leaving your job or position
senses.definitionCN: 正式声明将要离开工作或职位
senses.example: The finance director resigned that same day.
senses.exampleCN: 财务总监当天就辞职了。
senses.why: The Latin verb means to unseal or give back, and giving back a post is the modern core.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词意为开封交回，而把职位交回就是现代核心义。

senses.title: To give up a right or claim
senses.definition: to surrender a right, claim, or possession formally
senses.definitionCN: 正式让出权利、主张或所有物
senses.example: She resigned her claim to the property.
senses.exampleCN: 她放弃了对这处房产的继承主张。
senses.why: What is given back can be a right as well as a job.
senses.whyCN: 交回的既可以是职位，也可以是权利。

senses.title: To accept what cannot be changed
senses.definition: to accept an unpleasant situation because it cannot be avoided
senses.definitionCN: 因无法避免而接受不愉快的处境
senses.example: He resigned himself to another long wait.
senses.exampleCN: 他只好认命，再等下去。
senses.why: Giving up resistance inward produces the reflexive sense of resigning oneself.
senses.whyCN: 在内心里放弃抵抗，就产生「使自己顺从」的反身义项。

intro.en: Resign comes from Latin resignare, to unseal or cancel, from re- and signare, to mark with a sign.
intro.cn: resign 来自拉丁语 resignare（开封、注销），由 re- 与 signare（作标记）构成。

items.en: Signare means to mark or seal.
items.cn: signare 意为标记或盖章。

items.en: Resignare means to unseal or cancel a document.
items.cn: resignare 意为开封或注销文书。

items.en: Resigner means to resign or give up.
items.cn: resigner 意为辞去、放弃。

items.en: Middle English resignen means to give up a claim.
items.cn: 中古英语 resignen 意为放弃主张。

items.en: Resign is used for leaving an office.
items.cn: 到 16 世纪，resign 用于离开职位。

items.en: Modern English extends resign to accepting what cannot be changed.
items.cn: 现代英语把 resign 扩展到接受无法改变之事。

note.en: Resign is a handing-back verb, and it sits near its family and near verbs for quitting and surrendering.
note.cn: resign 是一个「交回」动词，与自身词族以及表示退出和让出的动词相邻。

entries.definition: the act or letter of leaving a job
to go away from a job or place
to give up something after resistance

normalIntro.en: Resign is re- plus sign: to sign a name back, as if returning the post.
normalIntro.cn: resign 是 re- 加 sign：把名字签回去，好像把职位交还。

normal.en: The Latin verb means to unseal or cancel, which becomes giving up a claim.
normal.cn: 拉丁动词意为开封或注销，后来变成放弃主张。

normal.en: Resign from a job is the usual pattern.

definition_en: to fight against something, or to stop yourself from doing something
core_image: 双手撑住一扇被猛推的门，不让它关上
scene: 居民联合起来反对在公园里建停车场。Residents joined together to resist the plan for a car park in the park.
sceneCN: 这里 resist 是「抵制」（第 1 个义项：反对并试图阻止）；句意：居民联合起来抵制在公园里建停车场的计划。

senses.title: To fight against something
senses.definition: to act against a force, plan, or person that tries to control you
senses.definitionCN: 对试图控制你的力量、计划或人采取对抗行动
senses.example: Residents joined together to resist the plan.
senses.exampleCN: 居民联合起来抵制这项计划。
senses.why: The Latin verb means to stand against, and standing firm is the core image.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词意为「站到对面」，站稳是核心意象。

senses.title: To refuse to accept
senses.definition: to refuse to accept a change, idea, or influence
senses.definitionCN: 拒绝接受某种变化、观念或影响
senses.example: Many staff resisted the new rules at first.
senses.exampleCN: 许多员工起初抗拒新规定。
senses.why: Standing against can be mental as well as physical.
senses.whyCN: 「站到对面」既可以是身体的，也可以是心理的。

senses.title: To stop yourself doing something
senses.definition: to stop yourself from doing something you want to do
senses.definitionCN: 阻止自己去做想做的事
senses.example: She could not resist the temptation to laugh.
senses.exampleCN: 她忍不住笑了出来。
senses.why: The urge is an inner push, and resisting is the self standing against it.
senses.whyCN: 冲动是一种内在推力，而抵抗就是自我顶住它。

intro.en: Resist comes from Latin resistere, to stand against, from re- and sistere, to take a stand.
intro.cn: resist 来自拉丁语 resistere（站到对面），由 re- 与 sistere（站定）构成。

items.en: Sistere means to cause to stand or take a stand.
items.cn: sistere 意为使站立、站定。

items.en: Resistere means to stand against or withstand.
items.cn: resistere 意为站到对面、抵挡。

items.en: Resister means to resist or oppose.
items.cn: resister 意为抵抗、反对。

items.en: Middle English resisten keeps the sense of standing firm.
items.cn: 中古英语 resisten 保留「站稳」的意思。

items.en: Resist covers both physical and moral opposition.
items.cn: 到 15 世纪，resist 兼指身体与道德上的对抗。

items.en: Modern English adds the sense of resisting temptation.
items.cn: 现代英语增加了「抵抗诱惑」的义项。

note.en: Resist is a standing-against verb, and it sits near its family and near verbs for opposing and withstanding.
note.cn: resist 是一个「站到对面」的动词，与自身词族以及表示反对和抵挡的动词相邻。

abstract.en: Imagine feet planted while a crowd pushes forward.
abstract.cn: 想象双脚钉住，人群却往前推。

abstract.en: Think of a guard holding a rope taut.
abstract.cn: 想象守卫把绳子绷得笔直。

examples.cn: 居民联合起来抵制这项计划。

senses.definitionCN: 认真决定去做或停止做某事
senses.example: She made a resolution to read every morning.
senses.exampleCN: 她下定决心每天早晨读书。
senses.why: The word names the mind settling on a course, like a knot finally pulled straight.
senses.whyCN: 这个词指心思终于定下方向，就像绳结最终被拉直。

senses.title: A formal decision by vote
senses.definition: a formal statement or decision agreed by a group or council
senses.definitionCN: 由团体或委员会表决同意的正式声明或决定
senses.example: The council passed a resolution against the plan.
senses.exampleCN: 委员会通过了一项反对该计划的决议。
senses.why: A group can settle its will as firmly as a person does.
senses.whyCN: 一个群体也能像个人一样坚定地定下意志。

senses.title: The solving of a problem
senses.definition: the act of finding an answer to a difficulty or dispute
senses.definitionCN: 为困难或争端找到答案的行为
senses.example: The resolution of the dispute took months.
senses.exampleCN: 这场争端的解决花了几个月。
senses.why: The Latin verb means to loosen, and solving a problem is loosening it.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词意为松开，而解决问题就是把问题松开。

senses.title: Image sharpness
senses.definition: the amount of detail a screen, image, or lens can show
senses.definitionCN: 屏幕、图像或镜头能显示的细节数量
senses.example: The photograph has very high resolution.
senses.exampleCN: 这张照片的分辨率很高。
senses.why: A high-resolution image can be resolved, or separated, into fine points of detail.
senses.whyCN: 高分辨率图像能被「解析」成细小的细节点。

intro.en: Resolution comes from Latin resolutio, a loosening, from resolvere, to loosen completely, built on re- and solvere.
intro.cn: resolution 来自拉丁语 resolutio（松开），源于 resolvere（彻底解开），由 re- 与 solvere 构成。

items.en: Solvere means to loosen, release, or pay.
items.cn: solvere 意为松开、释放或偿付。

items.en: Resolvere means to loosen completely or dissolve.
items.cn: resolvere 意为彻底解开或溶解。

items.en: Resolutio means a loosening or a settling.
items.cn: resolutio 意为松开、定解。

items.en: Resolution keeps the sense of a firm settling.
items.cn: resolution 保留「坚定定下」的含义。

items.en: Middle English resolution covers decisions and solutions.
items.cn: 中古英语 resolution 兼指决定与解决。

items.en: Modern English adds the sense of screen and image sharpness.
items.cn: 现代英语增加了屏幕与图像分辨率的义项。

note.en: Resolution is the noun of resolve, and it sits near its family and near words for decision and solution.
note.cn: resolution 是 resolve 的名词，与自身词族以及表示决定和解决的词相邻。

normal.en: The resolution of a problem is its solution.

branches.en: A formal vote settles a group's will.

branches.en: Solving a problem loosens its difficulties.

branches.en: Image sharpness separates a picture into fine points.

branches.cn: 解决办法与清晰图像都依赖把细节分清楚。

definition_en: to solve a problem, or to decide firmly to do something
core_image: 把一团乱麻一根根解开，直到线变得笔直
scene: 两家人坐下来谈了一个下午，终于把多年的地界纠纷解决了。The two families sat down for an afternoon and finally resolved their long dispute over the boundary.
sceneCN: 这里 resolve 是「解决」（第 1 个义项：把问题处理掉）；句意：两家人坐了一个下午，终于解决了多年的地界纠纷。

senses.title: To solve a problem or end a dispute
senses.definition: to find an answer to a problem or bring a disagreement to an end
senses.definitionCN: 为问题找到答案，或结束分歧
senses.example: The two families resolved their dispute.
senses.exampleCN: 两家人解决了他们的争端。
senses.why: The Latin verb means to loosen, and a solved problem is a loosened knot.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词意为松开，被解决的问题就是被解开的结。

senses.title: To decide firmly
senses.definition: to make a firm decision to do something
senses.definitionCN: 坚定决定去做某事
senses.example: She resolved to speak to him that evening.
senses.exampleCN: 她决心那天晚上和他谈一谈。
senses.why: A mind that stops wavering has settled, or resolved itself, on one course.
senses.whyCN: 不再摇摆的心思就「定」在了一条路上。

senses.title: To separate into parts
senses.definition: to break down or change into separate parts, used in technical description
senses.definitionCN: 分解或转变为不同部分，用于技术描写
senses.example: The mixture resolved into two clear layers.
senses.exampleCN: 混合物分成了两层清澈的液体。
senses.why: Loosening can mean a whole separating into its components.
senses.whyCN: 「松开」也可以指整体分开成各个组成部分。

intro.en: Resolve comes from Latin resolvere, to loosen completely, from re- and solvere, to loosen.
intro.cn: resolve 来自拉丁语 resolvere（彻底解开），由 re- 与 solvere（松开）构成。

items.en: Solvere means to loosen or release.
items.cn: solvere 意为松开、释放。

items.en: Resolvere means to loosen completely or dissolve.

items.en: Resolutus is the past participle, loosened or settled.
items.cn: resolutus 是过去分词，意为已解开、已定下。

items.en: Resolver means to resolve or settle.
items.cn: resolver 意为解决、定下。

items.en: Middle English resolven covers solving and deciding.
items.cn: 中古英语 resolven 兼指解决与决定。

items.en: Modern English adds the technical sense of separating into parts.
items.cn: 现代英语增加了「分解为部分」的技术义项。

note.en: Resolve is a loosening verb, and it sits near its family and near verbs for solving and deciding.
note.cn: resolve 是一个「松开」动词，与自身词族以及表示解决和决定的动词相邻。

normal.en: Resolve a dispute is the common phrase.

normal.en: The noun is resolution, the same loosening.

abstract.en: Think of muddy water settling until it is clear.

definition_en: a place people go for holidays, or the use of something as a last option
core_image: 海边一排小屋，人们拖着行李来这里放松几天
scene: 旺季时这座海滨度假胜地挤满了来自北方的游客。In high season the seaside resort is crowded with visitors from the north.
sceneCN: 这里 resort 是「度假胜地」（第 1 个义项：人们去度假的地方）；句意：旺季时这座海滨度假胜地挤满了来自北方的游客。

pos.zh: 度假胜地；手段；应急办法

senses.title: A place for holidays
senses.definition: a place where many people go to relax on holiday
senses.definitionCN: 许多人前往放松度假的地方
senses.example: The seaside resort is crowded in high season.
senses.exampleCN: 旺季时这座海滨度假胜地很拥挤。
senses.why: A resort is first a place people turn to for rest and pleasure.
senses.whyCN: resort 首先指人们为了休息和享乐而前往的地方。

senses.title: A last option or means
senses.definition: something used because no better option is available
senses.definitionCN: 因为没有更好选择而采用的办法
senses.example: As a last resort, we can walk home.
senses.exampleCN: 实在不行，我们可以走回家。
senses.why: The place one turns to becomes any resource one turns to in difficulty.
senses.whyCN: 所前往的地方，变成困难时所求助的任何手段。

senses.title: To turn to something for help
senses.definition: to use something, often reluctantly, because it is the only way left
senses.definitionCN: 因别无他法而使用某物，常带不情愿
senses.example: They had to resort to legal action.
senses.exampleCN: 他们不得不诉诸法律行动。
senses.why: The verb keeps the image of turning toward a place of help.
senses.whyCN: 动词保留「转向求助之处」的意象。

intro.en: Resort comes from Old French resort, a place resorted to, from resortir, to go back or go out again.
intro.cn: resort 来自古法语 resort（人们常去之处），源于 resortir（再出去、返回）。

items.en: Sortir means to go out.
items.cn: sortir 意为出去。

items.en: Resortir means to go back or come out again.
items.cn: resortir 意为返回、再出去。

items.en: Resort names a place people resort to.
items.cn: resort 指人们常去的地方。

items.en: Middle English resort means a place of assembly or help.
items.cn: 中古英语 resort 指聚集或求助之处。

items.en: Resort is used for places of holiday and pleasure.
items.cn: 到 16 世纪，resort 用于度假与游乐之地。

items.en: Modern English adds the phrase as a last resort.
items.cn: 现代英语增加了 as a last resort 这一说法。

note.en: Resort is a turning-to word, and it sits near its family and near words for destinations and options.
note.cn: resort 是一个「转向」词，与自身词族以及表示目的地和选择的词相邻。

normalIntro.en: Resort is a place one turns to: first a holiday place, then any last option.

normal.en: The verb resort to means turn to something for help.
normal.cn: 动词 resort to 意为求助于某物。

normal.en: A seaside resort is a place people travel to.
normal.cn: seaside resort 是人们前往的海滨度假地。

normal.en: As a last resort marks the final option.
normal.cn: as a last resort 标记最后的选择。

normal.en: The same word covers a place and a choice.

abstract.en: Picture suitcases rolling along a promenade.
abstract.cn: 想象行李箱沿着海滨步道滚动。

abstract.en: Imagine an empty road leading to the only open door.
abstract.cn: 想象一条空路通向唯一还开着的门。

abstract.en: Think of a hand reaching for the last tool in a box.
abstract.cn: 想象手伸向盒子里最后一件工具。

examples.en: The seaside resort is crowded in high season.
examples.cn: 旺季时这座海滨度假胜地很拥挤。

examples.cn: 实在不行，我们可以走回家。

examples.en: They had to resort to legal action.

dict_mnemonic.text: 「re + sort」——再次出发去某个地方，先想到的是度假地，最后才当作手段；这只是拆词联想，与词源无关。

sensesIntro.en: The word begins with a place people travel to for rest, then becomes any option people turn to when nothing better remains.

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a place people turn toward for rest or help.
core.cn: 核心意象：人们为了休息或求助而转向的地方。

branches.en: A holiday place is the most concrete sense.
branches.cn: 度假地，是最具体的义项。

branches.en: A last option is the place image turned abstract.
branches.cn: 最后手段，是「地方」意象的抽象化。

branches.en: The verb describes turning to that option.
branches.cn: 动词描述转向那个办法。

branches.en: People travel to a resort, and people turn to a last resort.
branches.cn: 人们前往度假地，也转向最后手段。

branches.en: The option and the act of using it are two sides of the same word.
branches.cn: 办法与使用办法的行为是同一个词的两面。

intro.en: Resort is a French noun and verb that English reshaped, and its small family grows with English endings.
intro.cn: resort 是经英语改造的法语名词兼动词，小词族由英语词尾扩展。

latinIntro.en: The French verb sortir means to go out, and resortir means to come back or go out again; the Latin prefix re- adds the return.
latinIntro.cn: 法语动词 sortir 意为出去，resortir 意为返回或再出去；拉丁前缀 re- 增添「返回」。

items.example: Re- adds the sense of returning.

items.meaning: to go back, come out again

items.meaning: a holiday place or last option

definition_en: something useful that can be used to achieve a goal
core_image: 仓库里整齐码放着工具、材料和食物，随时可以取用
scene: 岛上淡水有限，居民很早就学会珍惜每一份资源。Fresh water is limited on the island, so residents learned early to value every resource.
sceneCN: 这里 resource 是「资源」（第 1 个义项：可利用的有用之物）；句意：岛上淡水有限，居民很早就学会珍惜每一份资源。

senses.title: A useful supply
senses.definition: a supply of something such as water, fuel, or money that can be used
senses.definitionCN: 水、燃料或资金等可供使用的供应
senses.example: The country is rich in natural resources.
senses.exampleCN: 这个国家自然资源丰富。
senses.why: The word names a source to which one can return for help.
senses.whyCN: 这个词指可以反复回来求助的来源。

senses.title: Personal ability to cope
senses.definition: the ability to find a way through a difficult situation
senses.definitionCN: 在困难处境中找到出路的能力
senses.example: She showed great resource in a crisis.
senses.exampleCN: 她在危机中表现出很强的应变能力。
senses.why: A person's inner reserves are a resource drawn on in trouble.
senses.whyCN: 一个人的内在储备，就是困难时可取用的资源。

senses.title: A teaching or reference material
senses.definition: a book, website, or other material used for learning or reference
senses.definitionCN: 用于学习或查阅的书、网站或其他材料
senses.example: The website is a useful resource for teachers.
senses.exampleCN: 这个网站对教师来说是很有用的资源。
senses.why: Any material one can draw on for a task is a resource.
senses.whyCN: 任何可供任务取用的材料都是资源。

intro.en: Resource comes from French ressource, a source of help, from Old French resourdre, to rise again, ultimately Latin resurgere.
intro.cn: resource 来自法语 ressource（求助之源），源于古法语 resourdre（重新升起），最终来自拉丁语 resurgere。

items.en: Surgere means to rise.
items.cn: surgere 意为升起。

items.en: Resurgere means to rise again.
items.cn: resurgere 意为重新升起。

items.en: Resourdre means to rise again or recover.
items.cn: resourdre 意为再起、恢复。

items.en: Ressource means a source of help or recovery.
items.cn: ressource 意为求助或恢复的来源。

items.en: English resource covers means of support and available supplies.
items.cn: 到 17 世纪，英语 resource 涵盖支持手段与可用物资。

items.en: Modern English often uses the plural for a country's wealth.
items.cn: 现代英语常用复数指一个国家的财富。

note.en: Resource is a source one draws on, and it sits near its family and near words for supplies and means.

something valuable that can be used
a method or resource for doing something

normalIntro.en: Resource is a source one can rise back to: something useful kept ready.
normalIntro.cn: resource 是一个可以回头依靠的来源：随时备好的有用之物。

normal.en: The re- suggests rising again when needed.
normal.cn: re- 暗示需要时能再站起来。

normal.en: Natural resources are supplies taken from the earth.
normal.cn: 自然资源取自大地。

normal.en: Human resources are the people an organisation can draw on.
normal.cn: 人力资源是组织可以依靠的人。

normal.en: A resourceful person finds a way with very little.
normal.cn: resourceful 的人用很少的东西也能找到办法。

normal.en: Compare source: a source supplies, while a resource is a source you can use.
normal.cn: 对比 source：source 提供来源，resource 是可供你使用的来源。

abstract.en: Picture shelves of tools and food neatly stacked.
abstract.cn: 想象架子上整齐放着工具和食物。

abstract.en: Imagine a small boat with one oar used cleverly.
abstract.cn: 想象一条小船，靠一支桨巧妙前行。

abstract.en: Think of a teacher's box of ready-made materials.
abstract.cn: 想象老师一盒备好的教学材料。

examples.en: The country is rich in natural resources.
examples.cn: 这个国家自然资源丰富。

examples.en: She showed great resource in a crisis.
examples.cn: 她在危机中表现出很强的应变能力。

examples.en: The website is a useful resource for teachers.
examples.cn: 这个网站对教师来说是很有用的资源。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「re + source」——可以反复回去取用的来源，就是资源；这只是构词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 surgere（升起）→ resurgere（再起）→ 古法语 resourdre → ressource（求助之源）→ 现代英语 resource。

sensesIntro.en: The word starts with a source of help one can return to, then covers material supplies, inner coping ability, and learning materials.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个词从可以回去求助的来源开始，再涵盖物资储备、内在应变能力与学习材料。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a store of useful things ready to be drawn on.
core.cn: 核心意象：一批随时可取用的有用之物。

branches.en: Material supply is the basic modern sense.
branches.cn: 物资供应，是基本现代义项。

branches.en: Inner ability is a resource stored in a person.
branches.cn: 内在能力，是储存在人身上的资源。

branches.en: Learning material is a resource drawn on for a task.
branches.cn: 学习材料是为任务取用的资源。

branches.en: Countries and people both draw on reserves in hard times.
branches.cn: 国家与人都会在困难时动用储备。

branches.en: A clever person and a good website both help solve problems.
branches.cn: 聪明的人与好网站都能帮助解决问题。

intro.en: Resource is a French-shaped noun built on the Latin verb for rising again, with English endings forming its family.
intro.cn: resource 是建立在拉丁语「再起」动词上的法语形态名词，词族由英语词尾构成。

latinIntro.en: Latin surgere means to rise, and resurgere means to rise again.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 surgere 意为升起，resurgere 意为重新升起。

items.example: Re- adds the sense of rising again.
Resurgere joins the prefix and the root.
items.exampleCN: resurgere 把前缀与词根结合。

items.example: Resourdre carries the verb into French.
items.exampleCN: resourdre 把这个动词带入法语。

items.example: Ressource is the direct source of resource.
items.exampleCN: ressource 是 resource 的直接来源。
resource 保留「求助之源」的含义。

items.meaningCN: 表示状态或性质的词尾

definition_en: a feeling of admiration, or a particular aspect of something
core_image: 一个人后退半步，认真看着对方，身体微微前倾
scene: 那位老教师走进教室时，所有学生都站起来表示敬意。When the old teacher entered the classroom, every student stood up to show respect.
sceneCN: 这里 respect 是「敬意」（第 1 个义项：对某人怀有的钦佩与重视）；句意：老教师走进教室时，所有学生都站起来表示敬意。

senses.title: Admiration and esteem
senses.definition: a feeling of admiration for someone because of their qualities or achievements
senses.definitionCN: 因某人的品质或成就而钦佩他
senses.example: Every student stood up to show respect.
senses.exampleCN: 每个学生都站起来表示敬意。
senses.why: The Latin word means a looking back at someone, and that look becomes esteem.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词意为回头注视某人，这种注视就变成敬意。

senses.title: A particular aspect
senses.definition: one detail or point in which things can be compared
senses.definitionCN: 事物可以相互比较的某个细节或要点
senses.example: In this respect, the two plans are alike.
senses.exampleCN: 在这方面，两项计划很相似。
senses.why: Looking back at a thing can mean looking at one particular side of it.
senses.whyCN: 「回头看某物」也可以指看它的某一个侧面。

senses.title: To admire and treat well
senses.definition: to admire someone and treat them with care and fairness
senses.definitionCN: 钦佩某人并以体贴、公平的方式对待他
senses.example: She respects her teacher greatly.
senses.exampleCN: 她非常尊敬她的老师。
senses.why: The noun's esteem becomes the verb's way of acting toward someone.
senses.whyCN: 名词的「敬意」变成动词对待某人的方式。

intro.en: Respect comes from Latin respectus, a looking back, from respicere, to look back at, built on re- and specere, to look.
intro.cn: respect 来自拉丁语 respectus（回顾），源于 respicere（回头看），由 re- 与 specere（看）构成。

items.en: Specere means to look at.
items.cn: specere 意为看。

items.en: Respicere means to look back at or consider.
items.cn: respicere 意为回头看、考虑。

items.en: Respectus means a looking back or regard.
items.cn: respectus 意为回顾、注目。

items.en: Respect means regard or consideration.
items.cn: respect 意为重视、考虑。

items.en: Middle English respect covers esteem and a particular point.
items.cn: 中古英语 respect 兼指敬意与某个方面。

items.en: Modern English uses respect as both noun and verb.
items.cn: 现代英语中，respect 兼作名词与动词。

note.en: Respect is a looking-back word, and it sits near its family and near words for esteem and regard.
note.cn: respect 是一个「回头看」的词，与自身词族以及表示敬重和关注的词相邻。

entries.definition: public respect or a mark of it

normalIntro.en: Respect contains specere, to look: respect begins with looking at someone properly.
normalIntro.cn: respect 含有 specere（看）：尊重始于认真注视对方。

normal.en: Re- means back, and specere means look: to look back with regard.
normal.cn: re- 表示回，specere 表示看：带着重视回头看。

normal.en: Show respect is the common phrase.
normal.cn: show respect 是常见短语。

normal.en: In this respect means in this particular aspect.
normal.cn: in this respect 意为「在这方面」。

normal.en: Respectful is the adjective for showing regard.
normal.cn: respectful 是表示「恭敬的」形容词。

normal.en: Compare esteem: esteem is admiration, while respect also includes fair treatment.
normal.cn: 对比 esteem：esteem 是钦佩，respect 还包括公平对待。

abstract.en: Picture a student standing as a teacher enters.
abstract.cn: 想象老师进门时学生站起来。

abstract.en: Imagine a listener putting down the phone to look at you.
abstract.cn: 想象听者放下手机，认真看着你。

abstract.en: Think of a slight bow before a serious conversation.
abstract.cn: 想象严肃谈话前微微躬身。

examples.en: Every student stood up to show respect.
examples.cn: 每个学生都站起来表示敬意。

examples.en: In this respect, the two plans are alike.
examples.cn: 在这方面，两项计划很相似。

examples.en: She respects her teacher greatly.
examples.cn: 她非常尊敬她的老师。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「re + spect」——回头再看一眼，是因为心里看重，所以尊重；这只是构词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 specere（看）→ respicere（回头看）→ respectus（回顾、注目）→ 古法语 respect → 现代英语 respect。

sensesIntro.en: The word begins with a backward look of regard, which becomes esteem, then a particular side of a thing, and finally the way one treats another person.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个词从带着重视的回头注视开始，变成敬意，再指事物的某个侧面，最后指对待他人的方式。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: pausing to look at someone with attention and care.
core.cn: 核心意象：停下来，带着关注与体贴看着某人。

branches.en: Esteem is the feeling produced by that careful look.
branches.cn: 敬意是由认真注视产生的感受。

branches.en: A respect is one side of a thing seen closely.
branches.cn: 「方面」是近距离观察到的某个侧面。

branches.en: The verb turns esteem into fair treatment.
branches.cn: 动词把敬意变成公平对待。

branches.en: Feeling respect and acting respectfully belong together.
branches.cn: 心怀敬意与以礼相待彼此相连。

branches.en: Attention to detail and attention to people share the same look.
branches.cn: 关注细节与关注他人共享同一种注视。

intro.en: Respect is a Latin noun and verb carried through French, with English endings forming its family.
intro.cn: respect 是经法语传递的拉丁名词兼动词，词族由英语词尾构成。

latinIntro.en: Latin specere means to look, and respicere means to look back at or consider.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 specere 意为看，respicere 意为回头看、考虑。

items.exampleCN: re- 增添「回头看」的意思。

items.example: Respicere joins the prefix and the root.
items.exampleCN: respicere 把前缀与词根结合。

items.example: Respective shares the same Latin stem.
items.exampleCN: respective 共享同一拉丁词干。

definition_zh: 分别地；各自地；按顺序地
definition_en: in the same order as the people or things already mentioned
core_image: 两组名字并排排列，箭头一一对应
scene: 小明和小红分别获得第一和第二名。Xiaoming and Xiaohong finished first and second respectively.
sceneCN: 这里 respectively 是「分别地」（第 1 个义项：按前面提到的顺序一一对应）；句意：小明和小红分别获得第一和第二名。

pos.zh: 分别地；各自地；按顺序地

senses.title: In matching order
senses.definition: used to show that two lists match item by item in the order given
senses.definitionCN: 用于表明两个列表按给出的顺序逐项对应
senses.example: Tom and Anna scored ninety and eighty respectively.
senses.exampleCN: 汤姆和安娜分别得了九十分和八十分。
senses.why: The adverb of respective marks that each number looks back to its own person in order.
senses.whyCN: respective 的副词形式标示每个数字都按顺序回指各自的人。

senses.title: Separately, each in its own way
senses.definition: separately, with each item having its own place or role
senses.definitionCN: 分开地，每项都有自己的位置或角色
senses.example: The two plants were tested respectively in shade and sun.
senses.exampleCN: 两株植物分别在阴处和阳光下接受测试。
senses.why: The pairing idea can also stress that the items are handled separately.
senses.whyCN: 配对概念也可以强调各项被分开处理。

intro.en: Respectively is respective plus -ly, from Latin respicere, to look back, so it marks a look back to each item in order.
intro.cn: respectively 是 respective 加 -ly，源自拉丁语 respicere（回看），因此标示按顺序回指每一项。

items.en: Specere means to look.
items.cn: specere 意为看。

items.en: Respicere means to look back at each.
items.cn: respicere 意为回看每一项。

items.en: Respectivus means relating to each.
items.cn: respectivus 意为与各项相关的。

items.en: The adverb respectively marks item-by-item order.
items.cn: 副词 respectively 标示逐项对应的顺序。

items.en: Modern English uses it mainly in paired lists.
items.cn: 现代英语主要在成对列表中用它。

note.en: Respectively is the adverb of respective, close to its family and to words for order and separation.
note.cn: respectively 是 respective 的副词，与自身词族以及表示顺序、分开的词相邻。

normalIntro.en: Respectively is a pointing adverb: the first to the first, the second to the second.
normalIntro.cn: respectively 是「指认」副词：第一个对第一个，第二个对第二个。

normal.en: First and second respectively means in that same order.
normal.cn: first and second respectively 就是按同样的顺序。

normal.en: The adverb usually appears at the end of the paired list.
normal.cn: 这个副词通常出现在成对列表的末尾。

normal.en: Respectively never means respectfully.
normal.cn: respectively 绝不表示「恭敬地」。

normal.en: The adjective respective states the matching ownership.
normal.cn: 形容词 respective 陈述对应的归属。

normal.en: Compare separately: separately means apart, respectively means in matching order.
normal.cn: 对比 separately：separately 指分开，respectively 指按顺序对应。

abstract.en: Picture two columns of names joined by straight arrows.
abstract.cn: 想象两列名字被直线箭头一一连接。

abstract.en: Imagine two runners receiving two different medals.
abstract.cn: 想象两名跑者分别获得两枚不同的奖牌。

abstract.en: Think of two keys matched to two labeled locks.
abstract.cn: 想象两把钥匙分别对应两把有标签的锁。

examples.en: The two sisters are ten and twelve respectively.
examples.cn: 两姐妹分别是十岁和十二岁。

examples.en: The gold and silver medals went to Japan and Brazil respectively.
examples.cn: 金牌和银牌分别被日本和巴西获得。

examples.en: The boxes are marked red and blue respectively.
examples.cn: 这些盒子分别标为红色和蓝色。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「respective + ly」——一项一项「对着号」，就是分别地；这只是构词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 re-（向后）＋ specere（看）→ respicere（回看）→ respectivus → respective ＋ -ly → respectively，核心义「按顺序逐项对应」。

sensesIntro.en: Respectively first marks a one-to-one matching order, and then stresses that the matched items are handled separately.
sensesIntro.cn: respectively 先标示一对一的对应顺序，再强调被对应的事项分开处理。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two lists joined by one-to-one arrows.
core.cn: 核心意象：两个列表被一对一箭头连接。

branches.en: Matching order is the main modern use.
branches.cn: 对应顺序是现代主要用法。

branches.en: Separate handling is the secondary stress.
branches.cn: 分开处理是次要强调。

branches.en: The two lists match, and each pair is dealt with apart.
branches.cn: 两个列表彼此对应，每一对又分别处理。

branches.en: The order may run forwards or backwards as long as it matches.
branches.cn: 只要对应一致，顺序可以向前或向后。

branches.en: Two results can be separately reported and still fit one sentence.
branches.cn: 两个结果可以分别报告，仍能放进同一句话。

intro.en: Respectively is a Latin looking-back adjective turned into an English adverb.
intro.cn: respectively 是拉丁语「回看」形容词转化成的英语副词。

latinIntro.en: Latin respicere means to look back, and respectivus means relative.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 respicere 意为回看，respectivus 意为有关的。

items.example: Respectful belongs to the same root.

definition_en: to answer, or to react to something
core_image: 有人敲门，屋里的人立刻应声
scene: 老师提问后，她立刻举手回答。When the teacher asked, she raised her hand and responded at once.
sceneCN: 这里 responded 是 respond 的过去式，表示「回答」（第 1 个义项：用语言回应）；句意：老师提问后，她立刻举手回答。

derivatives.zh: 反应迅速的；回应积极的

senses.title: To answer in words
senses.definition: to say or write something in reply
senses.definitionCN: 用口头或书面方式作出答复
senses.example: She responded to the question with a smile.
senses.exampleCN: 她微笑着回答了这个问题。
senses.why: The Latin verb meant to promise in return, so answering is a return of words.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词意为「回以承诺」，因此回答就是言语上的回赠。

senses.title: To react to something
senses.definition: to act or change as a result of something
senses.definitionCN: 因某事物而行动或发生变化
senses.example: The patient responded well to the treatment.
senses.exampleCN: 病人对治疗反应良好。
senses.why: A reply can be an action as well as a sentence, so the word covers reactions.
senses.whyCN: 回应既可以是行动也可以是话语，因此这个词涵盖各种反应。

senses.title: To act on a need or appeal
senses.definition: to take action in answer to a request, emergency, or need
senses.definitionCN: 针对请求、紧急情况或需求采取行动
senses.example: Firefighters responded within minutes.
senses.exampleCN: 消防员几分钟内就赶到了。
senses.why: A formal reply to an appeal is carried out as an action.
senses.whyCN: 对呼吁的正式回应会落实为行动。

intro.en: Respond comes from Latin respondere, to promise in return, from re-, back, and spondere, to promise.
intro.cn: respond 来自拉丁语 respondere（回以承诺），由 re-（回）与 spondere（承诺）构成。

items.en: Spondere means to promise solemnly.
items.cn: spondere 意为郑重承诺。

items.en: Respondere means to promise or answer in return.
items.cn: respondere 意为回以承诺或答复。

items.en: Responsum is the noun for an answer.
items.cn: responsum 是表示回答的名词。

items.en: Respondre carries the answering sense.
items.cn: respondre 保留「回答」的含义。

items.en: Respond means to answer or react.
items.cn: 中古英语 respond 意为回答或反应。

items.en: Modern English extends respond to medical and emergency reactions.
items.cn: 现代英语把 respond 扩展到医疗与紧急反应。

note.en: Respond is the verb of the response family, close to answer and react words.
note.cn: respond 是 response 词族的动词，与表示回答和反应的词相邻。

normalIntro.en: Respond is a return word: something comes to you, and you send an answer back.
normalIntro.cn: respond 是「回赠」词：有东西来到你面前，你把回应送回去。

normal.en: Respond to a question means answer it.
normal.cn: respond to a question 就是回答问题。

normal.en: Patients may respond well to a new drug.
normal.cn: 病人可能对新药反应良好。

normal.en: Emergency teams respond to calls for help.
normal.cn: 应急队伍响应求助呼叫。

normal.en: The noun response names the answer or reaction.
normal.cn: 名词 response 指回答或反应。

normal.en: Compare reply: reply is mostly verbal, respond also covers actions.
normal.cn: 对比 reply：reply 多为口头，respond 也涵盖行动。

abstract.en: Picture a knock at the door and a voice calling back.
abstract.cn: 想象有人敲门，屋里传出应答声。

abstract.en: Imagine a plant turning its leaves toward the sun.
abstract.cn: 想象植物把叶片转向太阳。

abstract.en: Think of a hand raised the moment a question is asked.
abstract.cn: 想象问题刚提出就有一只手举起。

examples.en: He did not respond to my email.
examples.cn: 他没有回复我的邮件。

examples.en: The engine responds quickly to the pedal.
examples.cn: 发动机对油门反应迅速。

examples.en: Volunteers responded to the call for help.
examples.cn: 志愿者们响应了求助号召。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「re + spond」——把话「回」过去，就是回答；这只是拆词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 re-（回）＋ spondere（承诺）→ respondere（回以承诺、答复）→ 英语 respond，核心义「把回应送回原处」。

sensesIntro.en: Respond starts as a verbal answer, then becomes any reaction, and finally action taken in answer to a need.
sensesIntro.cn: respond 从口头答复开始，随后指任何反应，最后指针对需求采取的行动。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an answer sent back to the one who called.
core.cn: 核心意象：把答复送回给发问的人。

branches.en: A verbal answer is the basic sense.
branches.cn: 口头答复是基本义项。

branches.en: Any reaction extends the answer beyond words.
branches.cn: 任何反应都让答复超越语言。

branches.en: Answering an appeal becomes action.
branches.cn: 回应呼吁落实为行动。

branches.en: A patient and a student both give back a result.
branches.cn: 病人与学生都会给出一个回馈结果。

branches.en: Reacting quickly is the first step in helping.
branches.cn: 迅速反应是提供帮助的第一步。

intro.en: Respond is a Latin promising verb, and English builds response, respondent, and responsive on it.
intro.cn: respond 是拉丁语中表示承诺的动词，英语由它构成 response、respondent 与 responsive。

latinIntro.en: Latin spondere means to promise, and respondere means to promise or answer in return.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 spondere 意为承诺，respondere 意为回以承诺或答复。

definition_en: an answer, or a reaction to something
core_image: 一个球被抛出去，又立刻被抛回来
scene: 她的回答简短而有力。Her response was short and powerful.
sceneCN: 这里 response 是「回答」（第 1 个义项：对提问或信息的答复）；句意：她的回答简短而有力。

senses.title: A spoken or written answer
senses.definition: something said or written in reply to a question or message
senses.definitionCN: 针对问题或信息说出的、写下的内容
senses.example: I sent a short response to her letter.
senses.exampleCN: 我给她回了一封简短的信。
senses.why: The noun comes from Latin responsum, the thing promised or said back.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词来自拉丁语 responsum，即被回赠或回说之物。

senses.title: A physical or emotional reaction
senses.definition: a reaction of the body, mind, or system to something
senses.definitionCN: 身体、心理或系统对某事物的反应
senses.example: The medicine produced a strong response.
senses.exampleCN: 这种药产生了强烈的反应。
senses.why: A reply need not be verbal; any return effect is a response.
senses.whyCN: 回应不必是语言的；任何回馈效果都是 response。

senses.title: An organized reply to an emergency
senses.definition: the action taken by a group in answer to an emergency or appeal
senses.definitionCN: 群体针对紧急情况或呼吁采取的行动
senses.example: The flood response lasted three weeks.
senses.exampleCN: 这次洪灾应急响应持续了三周。
senses.why: An organized answer to danger is a large-scale extension of the reply idea.
senses.whyCN: 对危险的集体回应，是「答复」概念的大规模延伸。

intro.en: Response comes from Latin responsum, an answer, from respondere, to answer in return.
intro.cn: response 来自拉丁语 responsum（回答），源于 respondere（回以答复）。

items.en: Respondere means to answer in return.
items.cn: respondere 意为回以答复。

items.en: Responsum means an answer.
items.cn: responsum 意为回答。

items.en: Response carries the noun into French.
items.cn: response 把这个名词带入法语。

items.en: Response names an answer or reaction.
items.cn: 中古英语 response 指回答或反应。

items.en: Modern English adds medical and emergency responses.
items.cn: 现代英语增加了医疗与应急响应。

note.en: Response is the noun of the respond family, close to answer and reaction words.
note.cn: response 是 respond 词族的名词，与表示回答和反应的词相邻。

normalIntro.en: Response is the ball thrown back: question goes out, answer comes home.
normalIntro.cn: response 是被抛回的球：问题出去，答案回来。

normal.en: In response to means as an answer to.
normal.cn: in response to 表示作为对……的回答。

normal.en: A quick response is a fast answer.
normal.cn: quick response 是迅速的答复。

normal.en: The body can have a strong response to medicine.
normal.cn: 身体可能对药物产生强烈反应。

normal.en: Emergency response teams act during disasters.
normal.cn: emergency response 队伍在灾害中行动。

normal.en: Compare reaction: reaction is broader and less formal.
normal.cn: 对比 reaction：reaction 范围更广、更不正式。

abstract.en: Picture a ball bouncing straight back to the thrower.
abstract.cn: 想象球直接弹回投掷者手中。

abstract.en: Imagine a light switching on the moment a button is pressed.
abstract.cn: 想象按下按钮的瞬间灯亮起。

abstract.en: Think of a letter answered the same day it arrives.
abstract.cn: 想象一封信到达当天就得到回复。

examples.en: There was no response to our call.
examples.cn: 我们的呼叫没有得到任何回应。

examples.en: The audience gave the singer a warm response.
examples.cn: 观众给了歌手热烈的回应。

examples.en: The survey had a high response rate.
examples.cn: 这次调查的回应率很高。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「re + spons」——把答案「送回去」，就是回应；这只是拆词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 re-（回）＋ spondere（承诺）→ respondere（回以答复）→ responsum（回答）→ 英语 response，核心义「送回的回答或反应」。

sensesIntro.en: Response begins as a verbal answer, extends to any physical or emotional reaction, and finally to organized emergency action.
sensesIntro.cn: response 从口头回答开始，扩展到任何生理或情绪反应，最后指有组织的应急行动。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an answer returning to the source of the call.
core.cn: 核心意象：答复返回呼叫的源头。

branches.en: The verbal answer is the core sense.
branches.cn: 口头回答是核心义项。

branches.en: Any reaction extends the answer beyond language.
branches.cn: 任何反应都让回答超越语言。

branches.en: Organized emergency action is the public-scale sense.
branches.cn: 有组织的应急行动是公共规模义项。

branches.en: A patient and a reader both give back something.
branches.cn: 病人与读者都会给出回馈。

branches.en: Reacting to a flood becomes a coordinated response.
branches.cn: 对洪灾的反应发展成协调一致的响应。

intro.en: Response is a Latin answer noun, and English builds respond, respondent, and responsive around the same root.
intro.cn: response 是拉丁语「回答」名词，英语围绕同一词根构成 respond、respondent 与 responsive。

latinIntro.en: Latin spondere means to promise, and responsum means an answer.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 spondere 意为承诺，responsum 意为回答。

items.exampleCN: responsive 描述随时回应的状态。

definition_en: a duty to deal with something, or the state of being accountable
core_image: 一个人双手稳稳托着一件必须照看的东西
scene: 照顾年迈的父母是每个子女的责任。Caring for elderly parents is the responsibility of every child.
sceneCN: 这里 responsibility 是「责任」（第 1 个义项：应当承担并处理的事情）；句意：照顾年迈的父母是每个子女的责任。

senses.title: A duty to deal with something
senses.definition: a duty to take care of something or to do a job
senses.definitionCN: 照看某事物或完成某项工作的义务
senses.example: Feeding the animals is my responsibility.
senses.exampleCN: 喂养动物是我的责任。
senses.why: The noun is formed from responsible, which comes from a verb meaning to answer in return, so a duty is something you must answer for.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词由 responsible 构成，而 responsible 源于「回以答复」的动词，因此责任就是你必须作出交代的事。

senses.title: Accountability for a result
senses.definition: the state of being the one who must explain or be blamed for something
senses.definitionCN: 必须为某事作出解释或承担过失的状态
senses.example: The manager accepted responsibility for the delay.
senses.exampleCN: 经理承担了延误的责任。
senses.why: To answer for an outcome is to be accountable for it.
senses.whyCN: 对结果作出交代，就是对结果负责。

senses.title: A person or thing in one's care
senses.definition: a person or thing that one must look after
senses.definitionCN: 必须由某人照管的人或事物
senses.example: The children are her responsibility while their parents are away.
senses.exampleCN: 父母不在时，孩子们由她照管。
senses.why: A duty can be embodied in the very person or thing you must care for.
senses.whyCN: 责任可以具体化为你必须照管的某个人或某件事。

intro.en: Responsibility is responsible plus -ity, from Latin respondere, to answer in return, so it names the state of having to answer.
intro.cn: responsibility 是 responsible 加 -ity，源自拉丁语 respondere（回以答复），指必须作出交代的状态。

items.en: Respondere means to answer in return.
items.cn: respondere 意为回以答复。

items.en: Responsum means an answer.
items.cn: responsum 意为回答。

items.en: Responsible means answerable for something.
items.cn: 英语 responsible 意为对某事负责。

items.en: The suffix -ity forms responsibility.
items.cn: 词尾 -ity 构成 responsibility。

items.en: Modern English uses responsibility for duties and for accountability.
items.cn: 现代英语用 responsibility 指职责与问责。

note.en: Responsibility is the state noun of responsible, close to duty and accountability words.
note.cn: responsibility 是 responsible 的状态名词，与表示义务和问责的词相邻。

entries.definition: the duty to explain one's actions

normalIntro.en: Responsibility is what you must answer for: the duty is a question waiting for your reply.
normalIntro.cn: responsibility 是你必须作出交代的事：责任就是一个等着你回答的问题。

normal.en: Take responsibility means admit that it is your job.
normal.cn: take responsibility 表示承认这是你的责任。

normal.en: A sense of responsibility is the feeling that you must act.
normal.cn: sense of responsibility 是觉得自己必须行动的意识。

normal.en: Social responsibility means caring about others.
normal.cn: social responsibility 指关心他人。

normal.en: The adjective responsible means having the duty.
normal.cn: 形容词 responsible 意为负有责任。

normal.en: Compare duty: duty is a task, responsibility also includes being accountable.
normal.cn: 对比 duty：duty 是任务，responsibility 还包含问责。

abstract.en: Picture two hands holding a fragile bowl steady.
abstract.cn: 想象双手稳稳托住一只易碎的碗。

abstract.en: Imagine a key kept safe because it opens every door.
abstract.cn: 想象一把因能打开所有门而被小心保管的钥匙。

abstract.en: Think of a lighthouse keeper who never leaves the lamp.
abstract.cn: 想象一位从不离开灯火的灯塔看守人。

examples.en: She took full responsibility for the mistake.
examples.cn: 她为这个错误承担了全部责任。

examples.en: Teaching children is a serious responsibility.
examples.cn: 教育孩子是一项重大的责任。

examples.en: The job comes with many responsibilities.
examples.cn: 这份工作伴随着许多职责。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「response + ibility」——必须「回应」的事，就是责任；这只是构词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 re-（回）＋ spondere（承诺）→ respondere（回以答复）→ responsible（负责的）＋ -ity → responsibility，核心义「必须作出交代的状态」。

sensesIntro.en: Responsibility first names a duty, then the accountability for a result, and finally the very person or thing one must care for.
sensesIntro.cn: responsibility 先指职责，再指对结果的问责，最后指必须照管的人或事本身。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a duty held in both hands like a fragile bowl.
core.cn: 核心意象：像端着一只易碎的碗那样托着责任。

branches.en: A duty is the everyday sense.
branches.cn: 职责是日常义项。

branches.en: Accountability adds the answering-for sense.
branches.cn: 问责增加了「作出交代」的含义。

branches.en: The cared-for person or thing embodies the duty.
branches.cn: 被照管的人或事体现了责任。

branches.en: A duty that goes wrong brings accountability.
branches.cn: 职责出错时就会带来问责。

branches.en: Looking after a child is both a duty and a trust.
branches.cn: 照看孩子既是职责，也是信任。

intro.en: Responsibility stacks -ity on responsible, which itself comes from a Latin answering verb.
intro.cn: responsibility 在 responsible 上叠加 -ity，而 responsible 源自拉丁语「答复」动词。

latinIntro.en: Latin respondere means to answer in return, built on spondere, to promise.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 respondere 意为回以答复，建立在 spondere（承诺）之上。

definition_zh: 负责的；有责任的；可靠的
definition_en: having a duty, being the cause, or being reliable
core_image: 一个人手里握着一串钥匙，要对每扇门负责
scene: 值夜班的护士负责检查每一间病房。The nurse on night duty is responsible for checking every ward.
sceneCN: 这里 responsible 是「负责的」（第 1 个义项：负有职责、须对某事负责）；句意：值夜班的护士负责检查每一间病房。

pos.zh: 负责的；有责任的；可靠的

senses.title: Having a duty or being in charge
senses.definition: having the job of looking after something or someone
senses.definitionCN: 负有照看某物或某人的职责
senses.example: She is responsible for the whole team.
senses.exampleCN: 她负责整个团队。
senses.why: The word comes from a Latin verb meaning to answer in return, so the responsible person is the one who must answer.
senses.whyCN: 这个词来自意为「回以答复」的拉丁动词，因此负责的人就是必须作出交代的人。

senses.title: Being the cause of something
senses.definition: being the cause of an event, especially a bad one
senses.definitionCN: 是某事件的原因，尤指坏事件
senses.example: Heavy rain was responsible for the flood.
senses.exampleCN: 大雨是这场洪水的原因。
senses.why: The one who must answer for an event is often the one who caused it.
senses.whyCN: 必须为事件作出交代的人，往往就是造成事件的人。

senses.title: Reliable and sensible
senses.definition: able to be trusted to act sensibly and carefully
senses.definitionCN: 可以被信任，能明智谨慎地行事
senses.example: We need a responsible driver for the night trip.
senses.exampleCN: 夜间出行我们需要一位可靠的司机。
senses.why: A person who answers for their actions is likely to act carefully.
senses.whyCN: 能为自己的行为负责的人，往往会谨慎行事。

senses.title: Accountable to someone
senses.definition: required to report to a person or authority
senses.definitionCN: 须向某人或某机构汇报的
senses.example: The committee is responsible to the whole school.
senses.exampleCN: 委员会对全校负责。
senses.why: Answering in return also means answering to a higher authority.
senses.whyCN: 回以答复也意味着向更高权威作出交代。

intro.en: Responsible comes from Latin respondere, to answer in return, through French responsable, so it means answerable.
intro.cn: responsible 经法语 responsable 来自拉丁语 respondere（回以答复），因此意为「须作出交代的」。

items.en: Respondere means to answer in return.
items.cn: respondere 意为回以答复。

items.en: Responsum means an answer.
items.cn: responsum 意为回答。

items.en: Responsable means answerable.
items.cn: responsable 意为应负责的。

items.en: Responsible covers duty and cause.
items.cn: 英语 responsible 涵盖职责与原因。

items.en: Modern English adds the sense of being reliable.
items.cn: 现代英语增加了「可靠」的含义。

note.en: Responsible is an answerable adjective, close to its noun family and to words for accountability.
note.cn: responsible 是表示「应负责」的形容词，与自身名词词族以及表示问责的词相邻。

entries.definitionCN: 应作解释的；负有责任的

normalIntro.en: Responsible means answerable: if something goes wrong, you are the one who must respond.
normalIntro.cn: responsible 意为「须作出交代」：如果出了问题，你就是必须回应的人。

normal.en: Responsible for means in charge of or the cause of.
normal.cn: responsible for 表示负责或造成。

normal.en: Responsible to means answerable to a person.
normal.cn: responsible to 表示向某人负责。

normal.en: A responsible person acts carefully.
normal.cn: responsible person 行事谨慎。

normal.en: The noun responsibility is the duty itself.
normal.cn: 名词 responsibility 指责任本身。

normal.en: Compare accountable: accountable stresses reporting, responsible is broader.
normal.cn: 对比 accountable：accountable 强调汇报，responsible 范围更广。

abstract.en: Picture a person holding keys to every door in a building.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人拿着整栋楼每扇门的钥匙。

abstract.en: Imagine a driver checking the mirror before moving.
abstract.cn: 想象司机起步前检查后视镜。

abstract.en: Think of a captain standing steady at the wheel.
abstract.cn: 想象船长稳稳站在舵轮旁。

examples.en: The teacher is responsible for thirty students.
examples.cn: 这位老师负责三十名学生。

examples.en: Poor planning was responsible for the failure.
examples.cn: 计划不周是失败的原因。

examples.en: She is a responsible and careful worker.
examples.cn: 她是一位可靠而细心的员工。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「response + ible」——出了事必须「回应」的人，就是负责的；这只是拆词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 re-（回）＋ spondere（承诺）→ respondere（回以答复）→ 法语 responsable → 英语 responsible，核心义「须作出交代的」。

sensesIntro.en: Responsible first means having a duty, then being the cause, then being reliable, and finally being answerable to someone.
sensesIntro.cn: responsible 先指负有职责，再指是原因，再指可靠，最后指向某人负责。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a person holding keys and answering for every door.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个人拿着钥匙，为每扇门负责。

branches.en: Being in charge is the main sense.
branches.cn: 负责掌管是主要义项。

branches.en: Being the cause is the explanatory sense.
branches.cn: 是原因是解释性义项。

branches.en: Being reliable is the character sense.
branches.cn: 可靠是品格义项。

branches.en: Being answerable to an authority is the reporting sense.
branches.cn: 向权威负责是汇报义项。

branches.en: A person in charge should also be dependable.
branches.cn: 负责的人也应该可靠。

intro.en: Responsible is a Latin answering adjective reshaped by French, with a large English family.
intro.cn: responsible 是经法语改造的拉丁语「答复」形容词，拥有庞大的英语词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin respondere means to answer in return, from spondere, to promise.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 respondere 意为回以答复，源于 spondere（承诺）。

items.exampleCN: responsible 保留应负责的含义。

definition_zh: 休息；剩余部分；依靠；停止
definition_en: to relax, the part that remains, or to be supported by something
core_image: 一个人放下工具，靠在树边歇一口气
scene: 走了很远之后，大家在树荫下休息。After a long walk, everyone rested in the shade.
sceneCN: 这里 rested 是 rest 的过去式，表示「休息」（第 2 个义项：停止活动以恢复体力）；句意：走了很远之后，大家在树荫下休息。

senses.title: The part that remains
senses.definition: the people or things that are left after the others are taken
senses.definitionCN: 其他人或事物被拿走之后剩下的部分
senses.example: I ate one apple and kept the rest.
senses.exampleCN: 我吃了一个苹果，把其余的留着。
senses.why: This sense comes from a different root meaning to remain, and it names what is left behind.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项来自另一个意为「留下」的词根，指被留下的东西。

senses.title: A period of relaxation
senses.definition: a period of time spent relaxing or not working
senses.definitionCN: 用于放松或不工作的一段时间
senses.example: You look tired and need a good rest.
senses.exampleCN: 你看起来很累，需要好好休息。
senses.why: The oldest English sense is bodily rest, a pause from effort.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的英语义项是身体休息，即从劳作中暂停。

senses.title: To relax or stop activity
senses.definition: to stop working or moving in order to recover
senses.definitionCN: 停止工作或移动以恢复体力
senses.example: Let us rest here for a few minutes.
senses.exampleCN: 我们在这里休息几分钟吧。
senses.why: The verb turns the noun of relaxation into an action.
senses.whyCN: 动词把「休息」这一名词转化为动作。

senses.title: To be supported or based on
senses.definition: to be supported by something or to depend on it
senses.definitionCN: 由某物支撑或依赖某物
senses.example: The whole plan rests on one assumption.
senses.exampleCN: 整个计划建立在一个假设之上。
senses.why: Something at rest on a support is held up by it, which gives the sense of depending.
senses.whyCN: 静止在某支撑物上的东西由它托住，因此产生「依赖」的含义。

intro.en: Rest has two sources: Old English ræst, a pause from work, and Old French reste, from Latin restare, to remain.
intro.cn: rest 有两个来源：古英语 ræst（停工歇息）与古法语 reste（源自拉丁语 restare，留下）。

items.en: Ræst means a pause, sleep, or resting place.
items.cn: ræst 意为暂停、睡眠或休息之处。

items.en: Restare means to remain or stand back.
items.cn: restare 意为留下、留在后面。

items.en: Reste means the remainder.
items.cn: reste 意为剩余部分。

items.en: Rest carries both the pause and the remainder senses.
items.cn: 中古英语 rest 同时带有「休息」与「剩余」两种含义。

items.en: Modern English adds rest on, meaning to depend on.
items.cn: 现代英语增加 rest on，表示依赖。

note.en: Rest is a double-rooted word, close to its restful and restless family and to words for breaks and remainders.
note.cn: rest 是双词源词，与 restful、restless 词族以及表示休息和剩余的词相邻。

normalIntro.en: Rest is two words in one coat: the pause from work and the part left over.
normalIntro.cn: rest 是穿着同一件外衣的两个词：从工作中暂停，以及剩下的部分。

normal.en: Take a rest means stop and relax for a while.
normal.cn: take a rest 表示停下来放松一会儿。

normal.en: The rest of the cake is in the fridge.
normal.cn: 剩下的蛋糕在冰箱里。

normal.en: A plan can rest on a single assumption.
normal.cn: 一个计划可能只建立在一个假设上。

normal.en: Restful places help you sleep well.
normal.cn: 宁静的地方有助于睡好。

normal.en: Compare break: a break is shorter, rest can be a longer state.
normal.cn: 对比 break：break 更短，rest 可以是更长的状态。

abstract.en: Picture a traveler setting down a heavy pack.
abstract.cn: 想象旅人放下沉重的背包。

abstract.en: Imagine a spoon resting across the rim of a cup.
abstract.cn: 想象一把勺子横搁在杯沿上。

abstract.en: Think of the last slice left on a plate.
abstract.cn: 想象盘子里剩下的最后一片。

examples.en: We walked for hours and then rested by the river.
examples.cn: 我们走了几个小时，然后在河边休息。

examples.en: She read the first page and skipped the rest.
examples.cn: 她读了第一页，其余部分跳过了。

examples.en: The argument rests on weak evidence.
examples.cn: 这个论点建立在薄弱的证据上。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「rest」——像人「靠」在椅子上歇一歇，也是剩下的部分；这只是读音联想，与词源无关。

root: 古英语 ræst（歇息）＋ 古法语 reste（剩余，源自拉丁语 restare「留下」）→ 英语 rest，一身兼有「休息」与「剩余」两义。

sensesIntro.en: Rest first names what remains, then a pause for recovery, then the act of relaxing, and finally being supported by something.
sensesIntro.cn: rest 先指剩余之物，再指恢复体力的暂停，再指放松的动作，最后指由某物支撑。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a heavy pack set down and a body leaning back.
core.cn: 核心意象：沉重的背包被放下，身体向后靠。

branches.en: The remainder comes from the Latin remain root.
branches.cn: 剩余部分来自拉丁语「留下」词根。

branches.en: A pause for recovery comes from the Old English root.
branches.cn: 恢复体力的暂停来自古英语词根。

branches.en: The verb of relaxing turns the pause into action.
branches.cn: 休息的动词把暂停变为动作。

branches.en: Being supported links rest to reliance.
branches.cn: 被支撑把 rest 与依赖联系起来。

branches.en: Something at rest lies supported and still.
branches.cn: 静止之物躺在那儿，被支撑着不动。

intro.en: Rest has two roots, and its English family grows with -ful, -less, and -ing.
intro.cn: rest 有两个词根，其英语词族由 -ful、-less 与 -ing 扩展。

latinIntro.en: Latin restare means to remain, from re-, back, and stare, to stand.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 restare 意为留下，由 re-（向后）与 stare（站立）构成。

items.example: Restless describes a need to move.
items.exampleCN: restless 描述想要走动的状态。

definition_en: a place where you pay to sit and eat meals
core_image: 一间亮着灯的店，里面摆着桌椅和热腾腾的饭菜
scene: 我们在一家小餐馆吃了热汤面。We had hot noodle soup at a small restaurant.
sceneCN: 这里 restaurant 是「餐馆」（第 1 个义项：供人付费用餐的场所）；句意：我们在一家小餐馆吃了热汤面。

senses.title: A place serving meals
senses.definition: a place where meals are cooked and served to paying customers
senses.definitionCN: 为付费顾客烹饪并提供饭菜的场所
senses.example: We found a quiet restaurant near the station.
senses.exampleCN: 我们在车站附近找到一家安静的餐馆。
senses.why: French restaurant originally named a restoring broth, then the place that served it.
senses.whyCN: 法语 restaurant 最初指一种恢复体力的汤，后来指供应这种汤的地方。

senses.title: The business itself
senses.definition: the business or organization that runs such a place
senses.definitionCN: 经营这类场所的生意或组织
senses.example: The restaurant employs forty people.
senses.exampleCN: 这家餐馆雇用了四十人。
senses.why: A restaurant can be spoken of as a business, not only as a building.
senses.whyCN: 餐馆不仅可以指建筑，也可以作为生意来谈论。

intro.en: Restaurant comes from French restaurer, to restore, because the first restaurants served a broth believed to restore health.
intro.cn: restaurant 来自法语 restaurer（恢复），因为最早的餐馆供应一种被认为能恢复健康的汤。

items.en: Restaurare means to restore or rebuild.
items.cn: restaurare 意为恢复、重建。

items.en: Restaurer means to restore.
items.cn: restaurer 意为恢复。

items.en: Restaurant first names a restoring broth.
items.cn: restaurant 最初指一种恢复体力的汤。

items.en: The word shifts to the place that serves food.
items.cn: 这个词转为指供应食物的场所。

items.en: English restaurant names a dining place.
items.cn: 英语 restaurant 指用餐场所。

items.en: Modern English uses it for all kinds of dining businesses.
items.cn: 现代英语用它指各类餐饮生意。

note.en: Restaurant is a dining-place word, close to its French-derived relatives and to other eating places.
note.cn: restaurant 是表示用餐场所的词，与法语来源的亲属词以及其他餐饮场所词相邻。

entries.definition: a person who often eats out
a small place serving drinks and light meals
an informal word for a restaurant

normalIntro.en: Restaurant began as a restoring broth: food that puts strength back into you.
normalIntro.cn: restaurant 最初是一种「恢复体力」的汤：让你重新有力气的食物。

normal.en: A restaurant serves meals for payment.
normal.cn: restaurant 为付费顾客提供饭菜。

normal.en: A restaurant owner is a restaurateur.
normal.cn: 餐馆老板是 restaurateur。

normal.en: A restaurant chain runs many branches.
normal.cn: restaurant chain 经营许多分店。

normal.en: Fast-food restaurants serve food quickly.
normal.cn: fast-food restaurant 快速供应食物。

normal.en: Compare café: a café is smaller and often serves drinks.
normal.cn: 对比 café：café 更小，常供应饮品。

abstract.en: Picture a warm window with tables and lamps inside.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇温暖的窗，里面摆着桌子和灯。

abstract.en: Imagine steam rising from a bowl of soup.
abstract.cn: 想象一碗汤冒着热气。

abstract.en: Think of a waiter carrying plates between tables.
abstract.cn: 想象服务员在桌间端着盘子穿行。

examples.en: The restaurant was full by seven o'clock.
examples.cn: 七点时餐馆已经坐满了。

examples.en: He works as a cook in a French restaurant.
examples.cn: 他在一家法国餐馆当厨师。

examples.en: They opened a second restaurant last spring.
examples.cn: 他们去年春天开了第二家餐馆。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「rest + aurant」——进去「歇一歇」再吃顿饭，就是餐馆；这只是拆词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 restaurare（恢复）→ 法语 restaurer → restaurant（恢复体力的汤，后指供应食物的场所）→ 英语 restaurant，核心义「让人恢复精神的用餐处」。

sensesIntro.en: Restaurant first means the place that serves meals, and then the business that operates it.
sensesIntro.cn: restaurant 先指供应饭菜的场所，再指经营它的生意。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a lit room where hot food restores tired people.
core.cn: 核心意象：一间亮着灯的房间，热饭让疲惫的人恢复精神。

branches.en: The dining place is the everyday sense.
branches.cn: 用餐场所是日常义项。

branches.en: The business sense treats it as an enterprise.
branches.cn: 生意义项把它视为企业。

branches.en: A restaurant is both a room and a company.
branches.cn: 餐馆既是空间也是公司。

branches.en: A café, a diner, and a canteen can all be restaurants.
branches.cn: 咖啡馆、小饭馆与食堂都可以是餐馆。

branches.en: Chains and family restaurants differ in size, not in kind.
branches.cn: 连锁店与家庭餐馆规模不同，性质相同。

intro.en: Restaurant is a French restoring word, with English relatives restaurateur and restaurant-goer.
intro.cn: restaurant 是法语中表示「恢复」的词，英语亲属有 restaurateur 与 restaurant-goer。

latinIntro.en: Latin restaurare means to restore, and French restaurer keeps that sense.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 restaurare 意为恢复，法语 restaurer 保留这一含义。

items.example: Restaurer carries the word into French.
items.exampleCN: restaurer 把这个词带入法语。
restaurant-goer 在 restaurant 后加 goer。

definition_en: to bring something back to an earlier or better condition
core_image: 工匠把一件破损的旧物一点点修补回原样
scene: 洪水退去后，村民们一起修复被冲毁的石桥。After the flood went down, the villagers worked together to restore the damaged stone bridge.
sceneCN: 这里 restore 是「修复」（第 2 个义项：把受损的建筑修回原状）；句意：洪水退去后，村民们一起修复被冲毁的石桥。

senses.title: Bring back a condition
senses.definition: to make something return to its former condition
senses.definitionCN: 使某事物回到原来的状态
senses.example: The new manager quickly restored calm in the office.
senses.exampleCN: 新经理很快恢复了办公室的平静。
senses.why: The Latin source means to rebuild, so restoring is putting a good state back.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语来源意为重建，因此 restore 就是让良好的状态重新回来。

senses.title: Repair something old
senses.definition: to repair an old building, painting or object so that it looks as it did
senses.definitionCN: 修理古老的建筑、画作或物品，使其恢复原貌
senses.example: Experts spent years restoring the ancient temple.
senses.exampleCN: 专家们花了多年时间修复这座古庙。
senses.why: Repairing an old thing is a physical way of giving it back its earlier state.
senses.whyCN: 修复旧物，是以实物的方式让它回到早先的状态。

senses.title: Give something back
senses.definition: to return something that was lost or taken
senses.definitionCN: 把丢失或被拿走的东西交还
senses.example: The police restored the stolen painting to its owner.
senses.exampleCN: 警方把被盗的画作归还给了失主。
senses.why: Returning an object puts it back where it belongs, which is another kind of restoring.
senses.whyCN: 把物品送还原处，是另一种意义上的恢复。

intro.en: Restore comes from Latin restaurare, to rebuild, through Old French restorer.
intro.cn: restore 经古法语 restorer 源自拉丁语 restaurare（重建）。

items.en: Restaurare means to rebuild or renew.
items.cn: restaurare 意为重建或更新。

items.en: The prefix re- adds the idea of again.
items.cn: 前缀 re- 增加「再次」的含义。

items.en: Restorer carries the meaning into French.
items.cn: restorer 把这一含义带入法语。

items.en: English restore covers repair and recovery.
items.cn: 英语 restore 涵盖修理与复原。

items.en: Restore now also means to give something back.
items.cn: 现代英语中 restore 还表示归还。

note.en: Restore is close to words for repairing and bringing back.
note.cn: restore 与表示修理和带回的词相近。

entries.definition: to return to a normal state

normalIntro.en: Restore is re- plus store: put the good condition back into store again.
normalIntro.cn: restore 是 re- 加 store：把良好的状态重新存回去。

normal.en: Restore order means bring calm back.
normal.cn: restore order 意为把秩序带回来。

normal.en: Restore a building means repair it carefully.
normal.cn: restore a building 意为仔细修好建筑。

normal.en: Restore power means make the lights work again.
normal.cn: restore power 意为让电灯重新亮起。

normal.en: The noun restoration names the whole repair process.
normal.cn: 名词 restoration 指整个修复过程。

normal.en: Compare repair: repair fixes damage, restore also brings back the original look.
normal.cn: 对比 repair：repair 修好损坏，restore 还恢复原貌。

abstract.en: Picture a cracked vase slowly becoming whole.
abstract.cn: 想象一只裂开的瓶子慢慢变得完整。

abstract.en: Imagine a switch bringing a dark street back to light.
abstract.cn: 想象一个开关让黑暗的街道重新亮起。

abstract.en: Think of an old photo cleaned until the faces return.
abstract.cn: 想象一张旧照片被擦净，人脸重新显现。

examples.en: The medicine helped restore her strength.
examples.cn: 这种药帮助她恢复了体力。

examples.en: Workers restored the old theater to its former beauty.
examples.cn: 工人们把老剧院修复到了昔日的美丽模样。

examples.en: He restored the borrowed book to the library shelf.
examples.cn: 他把借来的书放回了图书馆的书架。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「re（再）＋ store（存放）」——重新存回原来的样子，就是恢复与修复；这只是构词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 re-（再）＋ restaurare（重建）→ 古法语 restorer → restore，核心义「让事物回到原来的良好状态」。

sensesIntro.en: Restore first means bring a condition back, then repair an old object, and finally return something to its owner.
sensesIntro.cn: restore 先指恢复状态，再指修复古物，最后指把东西归还原主。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a craftsman rebuilding a broken object piece by piece.
core.cn: 核心意象：工匠把破损的物件一块块重建起来。

branches.en: A condition is brought back to its earlier state.
branches.cn: 某种状态被带回早先的样子。

branches.en: An old building or artwork is repaired.
branches.cn: 古老的建筑或艺术品得到修复。

branches.en: A lost object is given back.
branches.cn: 丢失的物品被交还。

branches.en: Repairing an object also restores its lost value.
branches.cn: 修复物件也恢复了它失去的价值。

branches.en: Returning something restores the rightful order.
branches.cn: 归还原物恢复了应有的秩序。

intro.en: Restore is built from the Latin prefix re- and the rebuilding verb restaurare.
intro.cn: restore 由拉丁语前缀 re- 与表示重建的动词 restaurare 构成。

latinIntro.en: Latin restaurare means to rebuild, and re- means again.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 restaurare 意为重建，re- 意为再次。

items.example: Re- marks the return to a state.
items.exampleCN: re- 标记回到某种状态。
restaurare 是表示重建的动词。

items.example: Old French restorer carries the word to English.
items.exampleCN: 古法语 restorer 把词带入英语。

items.example: A restorer works on old objects.
